name: Boursa Kuwait Securities Company K.P.S.C.
summary: Boursa Kuwait Securities Company K.P.S.C., along with its various subsidiaries, operates and manages the stock market in Kuwait. Its comprehensive suite of services includes facilitating real estate investment trusts (REITs), overseeing rights issues, enabling short selling, arranging stock swaps, processing tender offers, and executing off-exchange transactions. Beyond trading activities, the company provides consulting expertise in administrative, economic, and information technology domains. Core operational functions involve offering clearing, settlement, and custodial services, alongside acting as a trustee. It is also responsible for central depository functions, maintaining share registers, and handling the transfer of ownership. The company was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.
